steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen to build a controlled saved draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required tenant configuration that prevents vendor addition during event creation.
Apply the required tenant configuration for stage addition behavior.
Give the draft a known title so it can be found in Drafts.
Configure the eRFX draft with an RFQ stage.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply a pricing template required for the draft and its line items.
Add one line item so the draft is a usable eRFX draft.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Save the configured eRFX as a draft instead of publishing it.
Confirm saving the draft did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the events list to verify and reopen the saved draft.
Show draft events.
Verify the plan's saved draft appears in the Drafts list.
Reopen the created draft on its create screen.
Open the terms and conditions editor requested by the case.
Verify that the Edit Terms & Conditions window opened.
Verify the expected named clause is shown.
